svg.title: Native Mac development: shared debug build and explicit review
svg.desc: The native API client stays engine-free. Validate physical and process architecture, Rosetta state, Rust host and pinned toolchain. Reuse the exact host/target/profile/features in the shared debug cache. Build a complete app before explicit launch on matching physical hardware. Execute selected Runtime scenes with synthetic effects and inspect PNG/tree output. Compiling a test or generating a capture is separate from executing and inspecting it; real Keychain behavior needs separate evidence. Embedded storage QA has its own heavy cold SurrealDB/RocksDB C++ graph. Backend and web provisioning remain independent operator work.
svg.text: ENGINE-FREE NATIVE CLIENT · ONE DEBUG GRAPH AND ONE BUILD OWNER
Select affected checks and fixture scenes
Physical CPU / process CPU / Rust host
Resolve Rosetta or host mismatch first
Warm reuse: the same exact debug graph
Print the exact app and artifact paths
Run selected synthetic scenes and input
Only --open, on the matching physical Mac
Separate embedded QA: heavy cold SurrealDB / RocksDB C++ compilation; reuse its exact graph.
Backend and web provisioning are independent operator work
The app connects to an authorized configured gateway. This host loop starts no Docker, database, index, inference or web relay.
Direct Docker commands own backend lifecycle. Preserve existing stacks, data, images and user configuration.
Compiled artifact ≠ executed test; generated capture ≠ inspected evidence; real Keychain behavior needs separate proof.
